# Policymaker (disclose.io)

> A free, open-source, account-free web tool that generates a deployable vulnerability-disclosure package from a four-step wizard.

Canonical: https://policymaker.disclose.io/
Publisher: disclose.io
License: open source (see https://github.com/disclose/policymaker)

## What it does
- Generates a customized **vulnerability disclosure policy (VDP)** from the pinned canonical language in disclose.io DIOTerms.
- Generates a standalone **safe-harbor clause**.
- Produces a **security.txt** file (RFC 9116) with your security contact and policy URLs.
- Produces normative **DNS Security TXT** records at `_security.<domain>`.
- Downloads individual artifacts or a seven-file ZIP with deployment instructions.
- Keeps answers only in the current browser tab; there is no policymaker account or backend persistence.

## How to use
Open the site, provide an organization and reporting channels, choose the disclosure timeline and safe-harbor options, then preview, copy, or download the outputs. Only semantically complete locale and policy combinations from the pinned DIOTerms revision are offered.

## Related disclose.io properties
- Canonical policy source: https://github.com/disclose/dioterms
- Application source and maintainer documentation: https://github.com/disclose/policymaker
- DNS Security TXT standard: https://dnssecuritytxt.org/
- Security-contact lookup: https://lookup.disclose.io/
